title: Evaluate the scratch Gaussian classifier
description: You inspect test metrics and a class-labeled confusion matrix.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You fit GaussianNaiveBayes with var_smoothing=1e-9 on training rows. The fitted model predicts X_test.
You compare predictions with y_test and print accuracy, F1, and a classification report. The recording includes both metrics.

steps.question: Which class has higher recorded recall?
steps.answer: Benign has recall 0.93, compared with 0.79 for malignant. The report lists supports of 72 and 42 respectively.

steps.description: You build a confusion matrix from the same test labels and predictions. The display uses cancer.target_names and prints its cell values as integers.
